list-upgradable.sh.name: List Upgradable
list-upgradable.sh.summary: Refresh the index and list pending upgrades on apt, dnf, apk, pacman, zypper or brew

examples.comment: Fedora/RHEL, with the changelog of each update
openSUSE, security and bugfix patches only
Arch, safe preview without touching the local database (pacman-contrib)

upgrade-all.sh.name: Upgrade All
upgrade-all.sh.summary: Upgrade every installed package on apt, dnf, apk, pacman, zypper or brew

examples.comment: Debian/Ubuntu, also removes packages when required by the upgrade
Alpine, reset every package to the repository version

installed-packages.sh.name: Installed Packages
installed-packages.sh.summary: Installed packages on apt, dnf, apk, pacman, zypper or brew

examples.comment: RPM systems, most recently installed first
Homebrew, formulae installed on purpose (not as dependencies)

package-owner.sh.name: Package Owner
package-owner.sh.summary: Which package installed a file, on dpkg, rpm, apk or pacman systems

examples.comment: The other way round: files installed by a package (Debian/Ubuntu)
Which package would provide a file not installed yet (Fedora/RHEL)

package-cleanup.sh.name: Package Cleanup
package-cleanup.sh.summary: Remove orphaned dependencies and caches on apt, dnf, apk, pacman, zypper or brew

examples.comment: Homebrew, preview what would be removed

package-history.sh.name: Package History
package-history.sh.summary: Recently installed or upgraded packages from the dpkg, dnf, pacman or rpm records

examples.comment: Fedora/RHEL, details of the last transaction
openSUSE, processes still using files deleted by an upgrade
